Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

MStargetR 1.5.0

Released 2026-07-07 (compare).

Bug Fixes

  • ci: resolve Bioconductor via bioconductor.org, not broken PPM mirror (4aa7819)
  • ci: route Bioconductor through Posit PPM mirror for archived releases (ad3f969)
  • gui: correct per-plot downloads, trim master_list RAM, keep logs in place (31e10ef)
  • qcCheckR: match user QC choice case-insensitively (e4414b9)
  • quiet diagnostics, cross-tab project dir, universal export, full R logging (87c7bcd)
  • timestamps: parse AcquiredTime slash formats as UTC, not session-local (1189b19)
  • workflow: pass mrm_template_list as named list and refresh params (edcc005)

Features

  • shiny: expose date_order selector in the QC tab (2982756)

MStargetR 1.4.0

Released 2026-06-12 (compare).

Bug Fixes

  • msConvertR: auto-rename raw_data files with spaces before msconvert (91f8a46)
  • qcCheckR: honour AM/PM seconds and ISO date-prefix hints in date detection (f7c185a)

Features

  • msConvertR: auto-discover plate grouping from filenames (e061d75)
  • msConvertR: group one-file-per-sample vendors into per-plate mzML (561ef5d)
  • qcCheckR: make instrumental LOD threshold configurable (4257c2b)

MStargetR 1.1.0

Released 2026-06-11 (compare).

Bug Fixes

  • ci: resolve R CMD check WARNINGs blocking build on release/oldrel (3b5c778)
  • deps: promote GUI runtime packages to Imports so they install by default (9e6cd99)
  • docker: allow Wine syscalls via seccomp=unconfined (DOCK-C6) (4d0ba57)
  • docs: correct vignette URL in README to articles/ pkgdown path (f81990c)
  • docs: repair Rd cross-reference and vignette logo path for clean check + pkgdown (f6e1c63)
  • plots: avoid cairo_pdf on macOS in save_figure to prevent R segfault (e560257)
  • plots: use exact-match indexing for pca$scores guard; clean up test warnings (8af6362)
  • qcCheckR: use mzML startTimeStamp for sample timestamps; resolve dmy/mdy at cohort level (2746c81)
  • reports: stream-embed resources to avoid pandoc OOM on large cohorts (a082cb8)
  • reports: unblock 54-plate cohort report+RDA exports on Windows (db9ce2d)
  • shiny: drop forced grayscale font-smoothing that blurs UI on Windows (7ff1e4a)
  • shiny: unbreak SH-013 audit by rewording comment (5886552)

Features

  • batch-correction: make combat_ref.batch usable in the GUI (ebfa586)
  • batch: add QC-RLSC robust LOESS signal correction method (62c7120)
  • container: add Apptainer/HPC support via enable_HPC dispatcher (6bb0675)
  • msConvertR: auto-discover plate grouping from filenames (e061d75)
  • msConvertR: group one-file-per-sample vendors into per-plate mzML (561ef5d)
  • plots: expose every GUI plot to R users via advanced_plots = TRUE (838e34e)
  • QC-RLSC batch correction, HPC/Apptainer support, and R-side plot parity (005cc1f)
  • qcCheckR: expose batch_column to mirror batchCorrectR + GUI (7c2278a)
  • qcCheckR: make instrumental LOD threshold configurable (4257c2b)

Reverts

  • Revert “chore(benchmark): add MStargetR vs MetaboAnalyst 6.0 benchmark suite” (af1e142)

MStargetR 1.0.0

Initial public release.

Features

  • Comprehensive workflow for targeted MRM mass spectrometry data processing
  • PeakForgeR() for automated Skyline document creation and peak integration via Docker
  • msConvertR() for vendor file conversion to mzML with parallel processing via Docker
  • qcCheckR() for quality control assessment with configurable QC types and ANPC filtering
  • batchCorrectR() for standalone interbatch correction with QCRFSC and ComBat methods
  • launchMStargetR() Shiny GUI for interactive pipeline execution
  • Interactive HTML report generation with plotly visualisations
  • Cross-platform support (Windows, macOS, Linux) with Docker integration
  • Comprehensive test suite and input validation
